title: Anthropic · 模型列表来源更新
summary: 新增了关于 capabilities.thinking.types.disabled 字段的说明，表明模型列表现在包含更详细的思考能力配置信息。

added_lines: Each model's capabilities object includes thinking.types.disabled, which reports whether the model accepts thinking: {type: "disabled"}, the setting that turns thinking off. supported is false when the model rejects "disabled" with a 400 error, and true on a model that doesn't support thinking. Even when supported is true, the API can still reject a "disabled" request for another reason. One such reason is an effort level that the model doesn't allow with thinking off.
